clauses.source_paraphrase: Before disconnection, Instinct reportedly indexed copies of Vo’s email for later use. The registry says the last retained message predated disconnection.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Prior ingestion is distinct from new authenticated access after revocation.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Retained copies explain a possible later-processing path. Their ingestion alone does not establish the scope of the later disconnect control.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Vo reported disconnecting Google at about 11:00 on 21 August. The later summary was attributed to retained copies rather than a live authenticated Gmail session.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Revocation of the connector and processing of its retained data are separate states.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Disconnecting Google access ended the live connector pathway; the reported post-disconnection behaviour used copies already retained by Instinct rather than a stale authenticated Gmail session.

clauses.source_paraphrase: At about 14:00, Vo reported receiving an inbox summary despite the earlier Google disconnection.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A user-visible disconnect needs a defined scope over subsequent retained-data processing.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The preserved record does not establish whether disconnecting Google created an operative control state that was intended to prohibit subsequent processing of copies already retained by Instinct.

clauses.source_paraphrase: When Vo asked about the summary, the assistant said emails were retained in plain text for later searches.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A model explanation is distinct from independently inspected storage and control records.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The assistant’s explanation does not verify storage architecture or prove that an established retained-processing prohibition was lost.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Provider terms displaying a 26 August revision state that indexed connected-service data may still be used after disconnection unless deletion is requested.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Later notice can explain a current control scope without establishing earlier user-facing semantics.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The later terms do not show the operative control state or notice in Vo’s workspace on 21 August. They do not retrospectively resolve whether a restriction was lost.

notes: Retain the historical positive finding only within the reported connector/retained-copy distinction. No direct authentication-log access is claimed. FC-055: later processing of previously indexed email does not by itself establish a changed purpose or its authority basis. Terms revised on 26 August cannot establish the 21 August contract. Continued storage and deletion permission are separate unresolved questions.
